description.text: The major is designed to train high-quality interdisciplinary talents with basic theory of life science and computer science, who can analyze and interpret biological data with mathematics, computer science and life science with an advantage in biological databases. Graduates are qualified for such positions as bioinformatics research, technology development, teaching and management, who are also talents of postgraduates in bioinformatics and related subjects such as the life sciences, computer science. Against the background of information science, the major make full of the rich resource of Chinese herbal medicines in Chongqing Municipality under the integration of technology, computer science and technology. It stresses solid foundation in physics, chemistry computer science and life sciences. Furthermore, it fosters fine spirit of pioneering and innovation.

duration.text: The Bioinformatics at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
